patch_description: Insert a mid-circuit parity-swapped RY + global RZ regularization block after the six-gate entangler and before the final rz_post stage. This adds three new parameters (ry_mid_0, ry_mid_1, rz_mid) with minimal overhead while leveraging the proven parity-alternating structure. The odd qubits (1,3,5,7) and even qubits (0,2,4,6) get different RY parameters, mirroring the front-end parity motif, followed by a broadcast RZ on all qubits. This should improve worst_group_margin and robustness to hard samples without pushing total parameter count beyond the sweet spot.
